name: detail-D-wall_roof-EXT_2X6_BOARD_BATTEN-ROOF

nodes.text:
Metal Sales Image II Striated 16 in, 24
ga, 70% PVDF Kynar 500 Linen White (81),
direct-fastened through nail flange

notes: • Roof: 11-7/8" TJI 230 at 24" o.c., LSSR hangers to a structural ridge beam.
• Bay: 5" ccSPF on deck, R-30C batt. Foam is the air and vapour barrier.
• Deck: 19/32" CDX, 40/20, oversailing the rafter ends to the girt face.
• Butyl membrane 240 F, full field + eave strip-in. 24 ga Image II, nail flange.
• Wall: 2x6, 1/2" ply, 4" ccSPF, 1/2" gap, KDAT girts, 3/4" BBD75. No WRB.
K2  Foam first lift 1-1/2" min; lap ridge beam and hanger flanges in one pass.
